SELECT o.status AS status, COUNT(o.id) AS count FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND o.created_at < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status ASC

SELECT COALESCE(pc.name, '未分类') AS name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price * oi.qty), 0) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN product_skus ps ON ps.id = oi.sku_id JOIN products p ON p.id = ps.product_id LEFT JOIN product_categories pc ON pc.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status IN
AND o.created_at >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND o.created_at < DATE_ADD(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

AND pr.store_id IN
